text: Please see a doctor to check your blood in stool, as it has lasted for 30 days [2, 3]. Blood in stool lasting more than 14 days has outlasted a self-limiting cause [2]. It is usually piles, but it should be examined rather than assumed [3]. Next steps include a colonoscopy, which is a camera test of the large bowel, a stool test for hidden blood, and a rectal examination [2].
